text:
taylor_pm: FYI we finished the VectorGrid V2 preliminary watt/throughput pass. I uploaded the summary + raw telemetry to the partner bucket: https://s3.vectorgrid/bench/v2/2024-10-03.zip. Topline: 410 tok/s, avg power 760W, perf/W 0.539 at seq=1024, batch=6.

rebecca_eng: nice. did you test both PCIe gen settings? i remember VectorGrid had a gen3 fallback on some boards.

dmitri_hw: we ran on native PCIe4, pstate locked to P0, fan curve at default. we also did a quick gen3 run — perf dropped ~8% and perf/W dropped to 0.49. notes in the CSV.

josh_qa: can you paste the exact bench command and env vars? QA needs to reproduce in our lab image.

rebecca_eng: command below (run inside vg-bench container):

```
VG_BENCH_MODE=energy VG_SEQ=1024 VG_BATCH=6 ./vg-bench --model redwood/gptq-65b --quant q5_0 --duration 2400 --telemetry-endpoint https://telemetry.redwood/api/v1/push
```

ops_bot: Logs archived -> https://logs.redwood/internal/vectorgrid/v2/2024-10-03 (sha256: a7f9...). Telemetry includes power_w, socket_temp_c, pci_link_speed, kernel_params every 30s. :package:

rebecca_eng: couple of important diffs vs our baseline: 1) we enabled TensorCores-boost patch on VectorGrid FW, 2) `kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns` was lowered to 200000. both noted in the headers of the CSV.

dmitri_hw: also toggled `pcie_aspm=off` for stability — that saved a few watts under steady load.

josh_qa: QA checklist for repro: 1) same FW + bios, 2) PCIe4 + pstate P0, 3) run 40m to reach thermal steady state, 4) collect 30s power samples. I'll create infra-qa/vectorgrid-v2-repro and attach artifacts.

rebecca_eng: for the kernel tuning sweep we want to try these toggles: `tc_boost=on/off`, `pcie_aspm=off/on`, `matmul_tile=64/32`, `batch=[6,8,10]`, seq [512,1024,2048]. we'll compare perf/W and 95th latency.

rebecca_eng: gating for public co-announcement: must meet BOTH: (A) perf/W >= 0.58 vs our internal 0.50 baseline (so >16% improvement), AND (B) 95th latency at seq=1024 < 120ms. otherwise keep as partner case study only.

josh_qa: starting reproduction now. if we see >10% variance on perf/W vs these numbers, i'll flag and request joint debug.

dmitri_hw: small caveat: VectorGrid disabled turbo boost on some systems due to thermal packing — that reduced single-shot tail perf but improved sustained perf/W. check the FW note.

taylor_pm: communications: partnerships will draft a short co-marketing brief if QA reproduces within 7%. we'll prepare embargoed talking points and data table. I'll loop in legal for partner quotes.

ops_bot: Calendar: proposed tune sweep sync Thu 10/07 09:30 PT. Invite created: https://calendar.redwood/event/vectorgrid-v2-watt-sweep. :calendar:

rebecca_eng: one more ask for infra: include per-socket traces and GPU-freq history in the telemetry export. we want to correlate freq downshifts with power dips.

josh_qa: attaching first reproduction artifact to the ticket now. if stable, i'll run the matmul_tile=32 sweep tomorrow and post numbers.

dmitri_hw: thanks all. VectorGrid ENG indicated they'll run an internal mirror sweep and share artifacts. i'll coordinate their upload.

taylor_pm: perfect. thanks team — nicely scoped. :handshake:
